description: This file defines a Java interface for building Timer objects, providing methods to add tags, single tags, and to build the Timer.

classes.name: TimerBuilder
classes.description: A generic interface for building Timer objects with methods for adding tags and constructing the Timer.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Adds multiple tags to the timer; existing tags with same keys will be overridden.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a single tag to the timer; existing tag with the same key will be overridden.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Timer object.
